verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 118.3 (+5.2% in a day) and momentum is 45: prices are steady. 84s cost 850, 85s 2,500 and 86s 4,200. Rivals rewards just paid out, so fodder supply is high this morning.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-29T12:20:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Buy 86-rated fodder after Rivals rewards, sell or use by Saturday
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 3,100 coins. Now 4,200. Rivals rewards dip: Rivals rewards flood the market with fodder on Thursday morning, and SBC demand lifts it again by the weekend. Picked because it is the cheapest 86 is 3,100 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 1 so far, averaging +19.8% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Rivals rewards just paid out: buy SBC fodder now, not later
moves.detail: Rewards add fodder to the market on Thursday morning, which usually makes it cheapest then. Buy what your SBCs need now; selling it again costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 850 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,500 (1.19 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,200 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,500 (1.18 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,750 (1.42 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 86s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Yan Diomande and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Yan Diomande 84 Rare -54.4%; Alexander Isak 86 Rare -31.1%; Vicky López 84 Rare -30.4%; Aurélien Tchouaméni 84 Rare -28.4%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Premier League POTM September SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 23.2K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
